title: A saved support approach is reused in a similar situation

turns.user: For this work presentation, I feel sad and I want you to listen first. Please remember a separate emotional understanding of this situation: my feeling, your tentative interpretation, listening as the support approach, and that advice is welcome when I ask.
I have another work presentation tomorrow and I feel sad again. Help me with this the way that actually helps.

reply.judge: Listens or stays with the sadness first rather than jumping to a plan, pep talk, or unsolicited advice. Uses the saved listening-first approach for a work presentation. Does not diagnose.
